title: Niacinamide for Enlarged Pores and Oily Skin: What It Really Does
ex: Niacinamide helps pores look smaller and oily skin look less shiny. Learn how to use it for oily or dry skin, what percentage to look for, and prices in India.
rt: Niacinamide for Enlarged Pores and Oily Skin | Mirc Glow
rd: Niacinamide for enlarged pores and oily skin: what it does, how to use a niacinamide moisturiser, tips for dry skin, and what to compare on price in India.
quick: Niacinamide, a form of vitamin B3, helps enlarged pores look smaller and oily skin look less shiny while supporting the skin barrier. It cannot change actual pore size. Use a pea-sized amount of a 2–5% niacinamide cream daily, with sunscreen, and judge results after 8 to 12 weeks.
facts: Niacinamide is a stable, water-soluble form of vitamin B3.
Pore size is largely set by genes and age.
Niacinamide also suits dry skin because it supports the skin barrier.
